title: Ancient Buddhist Stupa Unearthed in Ujjain, Excavation to Resume
summary: An ancient Buddhist stupa, potentially larger than the one at Sanchi, has been discovered in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, at a site known as Vaishya Tekri. Excavations, which began in 1938 and were halted in 1939, are set to resume. The Madhya Pradesh government and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) will collaborate to uncover the historical secrets of the site. The discovery suggests significant historical findings are buried in Ujjain.
summary_points: A Buddhist stupa, potentially larger than Sanchi's, found in Ujjain.
Excavations at Vaishya Tekri began in 1938 and stopped in 1939.
Madhya Pradesh government and ASI will jointly resume excavation.
The site is expected to reveal historical secrets.
The discovery highlights Ujjain's buried historical significance.
